title: The Observer, Consciousness, and Automorphism Stabilizers
thesis: An observer is interpreted as the stabilizer subgroup of Aut(W(3,3)) that fixes an edge-mode configuration.

definitions.measurement: stabilizer restriction from O(C) to O(C')

claims: The observer is not external to the theory.
Wavefunction collapse is modeled as stabilizer restriction.
Complementarity is modeled by disjoint edge configurations with commuting stabilizers.
Anthropic selection is replaced by Turing-complete stabilizer selection.
